cues.en: Instructor: In this video, I'm going to continue the discussion that I started two videos ago about when to use lines versus bars for histograms.
cues.zh: 這部影片延續前兩部的討論，直方圖何時用線、何時用長條。

cues.en: And essentially I'm going to illustrate to you one area, one example where even though technically, you know, by the letter of the statistical law book,
cues.zh: 基本上，要展示一個例子，雖然嚴格依照統計規則，

cues.en: we should be using bars, but we are going to be using lines and I think you will agree that it will improve things a lot.
cues.zh: 應該用長條，但我們會用線，相信你會同意，這能大幅改善呈現。

cues.en: All right, so let's go on.
cues.zh: 繼續。

cues.en: So we are going to create three data sets.
cues.zh: 建立三個資料集。

cues.en: These are all log-normal data sets.
cues.zh: 全是對數常態資料集。

cues.en: You can see it's random numbers, a thousand of them.
cues.zh: 可以看到，有一千個隨機數。

cues.en: Random numbers that I input into the natural exponential function.
cues.zh: 把隨機數送進自然指數函數。

cues.en: And then I'm just changing the shape of these distributions a little bit.
cues.zh: 再稍微改變分布形狀。

cues.en: You don't have to worry about these parameters for now.
cues.zh: 目前不用擔心這些參數。

cues.en: You'll learn more about that in the future.
cues.zh: 之後會更深入學習。

cues.en: But the main point is that we're going to have three different data sets that have slightly different distributions.
cues.zh: 重點是，有三個分布稍微不同的資料集。

cues.en: Okay? So run these data.
cues.zh: 執行這些資料。

cues.en: And now here what I'm going to do is draw three histograms all on top of each other for the three different data sets using k equals 20.
cues.zh: 現在對三個資料集，使用K=20，將三個直方圖疊在一起。

cues.en: So yeah, I mean, I don't know, is this really, really horrible?
cues.zh: 嗯，這是不是很糟糕？

cues.en: It looks pretty uninterpretable to me.
cues.zh: 對我而言，相當難以解讀。

cues.en: I mean maybe it looks kind of nice because MATLAB figured out that it should use some transparency so you can see the bars behind.
cues.zh: 也許看起來還算好看，因為MATLAB知道要加透明度，讓你看見後面的長條。

cues.en: But this is not really a very useful way of visualizing the data.
cues.zh: 但這並不是非常有用的資料視覺化方式。

cues.en: It's certainly not a very useful way of visualizing the differences in the shapes, the distributions between these three different data sets.
cues.zh: 尤其無法有效看出三個資料集的分布形狀差異。

cues.en: So instead what I'm going to do is use the plot function.
cues.zh: 所以改用plot函式。

cues.en: So I'm going to plot lines instead of bars using the plot function.
cues.zh: 用plot畫線，而非長條。

cues.en: The plot function, the basic use of the plot function is pretty straightforward.
cues.zh: plot的基本用法很直接。

cues.en: We input the x values and we input the y values.
cues.zh: 輸入x值與y值。

cues.en: So the x axis coordinates and the heights of each point of the elements in the line.
cues.zh: 也就是x軸座標，以及線上每個點、元素的高度。

cues.en: And then the rest of this line of code is really just to make the plot look a little bit nicer.
cues.zh: 這行其餘程式碼，只是讓圖好看一點。

cues.en: So I'm specifying that dataset one is going to be squares.
cues.zh: 指定第一個資料集用方形。

cues.en: Dataset two is going to have circles.
cues.zh: 第二個用圓圈。

cues.en: Dataset three is going to have this caret symbol, I believe that goes for diamonds.
cues.zh: 第三個用這個尖角符號，我想代表菱形。

cues.en: We'll see what it looks like.
cues.zh: 看看結果。

cues.en: Oh, no wait, it's triangles here.
cues.zh: 喔，等等，是三角形。

cues.en: Diamonds would be a D.
cues.zh: 菱形應該是D。

cues.en: Okay and then setting the marker size and so on.
cues.zh: 接著設定標記大小等。

cues.en: You can play around with all these parameters if you like.
cues.zh: 如果願意，可以調整這些參數。

cues.en: Okay and then up here what I'm doing is running code that I've shown you before.
cues.zh: 上面執行的是之前展示過的程式碼。

cues.en: So using histcounts, and then I have to adjust the x-axis coordinates to take the average of the bin boundaries, which means the center of the bins
cues.zh: 使用histcounts，再調整x軸座標，把區間邊界取平均，也就是區間中心，

cues.en: instead of just the boundaries themselves.
cues.zh: 而不是邊界本身。

cues.en: And then here, this final line of code here, I'm converting all of the counts into probabilities, or actually this is proportion.
cues.zh: 最後一行，把所有次數轉成機率，其實是比例。

cues.en: So this should be familiar from the unsupervised learning challenge several videos ago, where you modified the histogram code
cues.zh: 這應該很熟悉，前幾部的自主學習挑戰中，修改過直方圖程式，

cues.en: to plot proportion instead of the raw counts.
cues.zh: 改畫比例，而非原始次數。

cues.en: And I can already see that this is also wrong.
cues.zh: 我已經看出，這裡也錯了。

cues.en: So this should say, either this should be a proportion or I should multiply these by 100 so that they are actually probabilities.
cues.zh: 這應該寫比例，或者把它們乘100，才真正是機率。

cues.en: I think I'll do that latter.
cues.zh: 我想採用後者。

cues.en: So I'll say 100 times.
cues.zh: 寫成100乘上。

cues.en: 100 times and then 100 times here.
cues.zh: 100乘上，這裡也100乘上。

cues.en: Okay, so now we run this and now I think we can all agree that this is a better way to visualize the data.
cues.zh: 現在執行，相信大家都同意，這是比較好的資料視覺化方式。

cues.en: You can see the different distributions more clearly in this plot compared to this plot where the bars are all overlying each other.
cues.zh: 相較所有長條疊在一起，這張圖更清楚顯示不同分布。

cues.en: All right, so we are going to start here by creating the data for the distribution.
cues.zh: 這裡同樣先建立分布資料。

cues.en: So I'm going to create log-normal distributed numbers, just as I've shown before in a couple of previous videos.
cues.zh: 產生對數常態分布數字，和前幾部展示的一樣。

cues.en: And you can see there's three different data sets that I'm creating.
cues.zh: 可以看到，建立三個不同資料集。

cues.en: They're all very similar in the sense that they're all log-normal distributions, but they're going to be a little bit different, partly because there's just different random numbers that are going into it.
cues.zh: 全都是對數常態分布，所以很相似，但仍稍有差別，部分因為輸入的隨機數不同。

cues.en: And partly because I'm changing the shapes of these distributions.
cues.zh: 部分因為我改變了分布形狀。

cues.en: So I'm changing here with this divisive factor or you can think of this as an inverse multiplicative factor.
cues.zh: 這裡用這個除法因子，也可以看作倒數的乘法因子，

cues.en: I'm changing the widths of the distributions and here I'm changing the mean of the distribution.
cues.zh: 改變分布寬度，這裡則改變平均值。

cues.en: I'm gonna talk more about log-normal distributions and other kinds of distributions later on.
cues.zh: 之後會更詳細介紹對數常態與其他分布。

cues.en: For now, the purposes of this video, it doesn't really matter.
cues.zh: 對這部影片而言，目前不重要。

cues.en: The point is that we're going to have three distributions and we're gonna see what happens when we plot them all on top of each other.
cues.zh: 重點是有三種分布，看看疊在同一張圖會怎樣。

cues.en: So in one plot, I'm going to generate histograms with 20 bins for all three of these data sets.
cues.zh: 在同一張圖上，為三個資料集產生20個區間的直方圖。

cues.en: And here's what it looks like.
cues.zh: 結果長這樣。

cues.en: It's pretty difficult to really make a lot of sense out of it.
cues.zh: 很難真正理解。

cues.en: In part because there's no transparency, we don't actually see what's happening behind the green bars.
cues.zh: 部分原因是沒有透明度，看不出綠色長條後面發生什麼。

cues.en: So you have no idea what this orange data set looks like and what this blue data set will look like.
cues.zh: 所以不知道橘色與藍色資料集是什麼樣子。

cues.en: They could be going up here, they could be bimodally distributed, they could be flat all the way here.
cues.zh: 可能上升到這裡，可能是雙峰分布，也可能一直平坦到這裡。

cues.en: It's really impossible to say.
cues.zh: 實在無從判斷。

cues.en: So I think we can all agree that this is not really a useful way of visualizing these three data sets in the same plot.
cues.zh: 所以相信大家同意，這不是在同一張圖呈現三個資料集的好方法。

cues.en: So for that reason, we are going to switch to using lines.
cues.zh: 因此改用線條。

cues.en: Even though, as I mentioned a few videos ago, technically, you know, if you look in a stats law book, it's gonna say histograms are discretized.
cues.zh: 雖然如前幾部提過，嚴格看統計規則，直方圖是離散化的，

cues.en: So you can only use bars and not lines connecting them, but I think you'll agree that the plots here will look much nicer.
cues.zh: 應該只用長條，不用線連接，但相信你同意，這裡畫線會好看很多。

cues.en: So we use the plot function, it's pretty simple to use.
cues.zh: 使用plot函式，很簡單。

cues.en: We plot x values by y values.
cues.zh: 畫x值對y值。

cues.en: And then I'm adding a couple of additional inputs here.
cues.zh: 接著加入幾個額外輸入。

cues.en: So we have, gonna be dataset one for squares, dataset two is gonna be plotted with circles, and dataset three will be plotted with little triangles.
cues.zh: 第一個資料集用方形，第二個用圓圈，第三個用小三角形。

cues.en: Okay, and now I noticed in the MATLAB code that there's a little bit of a small mistake here.
cues.zh: 我在MATLAB程式裡注意到，這裡有個小錯誤。

cues.en: I'm actually converting these into proportion, whereas it says here, probability and the y axis label is probability.
cues.zh: 實際上轉成的是比例，但這裡與y軸標籤，都寫機率。

cues.en: So these are proportion because I'm redefining each y value to be itself divided by the sum over all of the y-axis values,
cues.zh: 這些是比例，因為重新定義每個y值為它本身，除以所有y軸值的總和，

cues.en: all the histogram counts.
cues.zh: 也就是所有直方圖次數。

cues.en: So a line of code like this should look familiar from the unsupervised learning video, that little code challenge several videos ago.
cues.zh: 這行應該很熟悉，來自前幾部自主學習影片的程式小挑戰。

cues.en: Now this isn't wrong, of course, but this is proportion and this says probability.
cues.zh: 這當然不是錯，但它是比例，這裡卻寫機率。

cues.en: So just to make things a little bit more accurate and a little more consistent, I'm going to multiply all of these by 100, and that actually does give us probability.
cues.zh: 為了更準確、一致，把所有值乘100，這才會得到機率。

cues.en: Okay, so now we've run this plot.
cues.zh: 現在執行這張圖。

cues.en: And again, I think we can all agree that this plot is not very useful for visualizing these three data distributions.
cues.zh: 相信大家同意，這張圖對展示這三個分布，並不實用。

cues.en: And this plot actually is very useful for visualizing the differences between these different distributions.
cues.zh: 而這張圖，對呈現分布差異非常有用。
